cases.input: A capability assessment pins subject, method, criteria, scale version, evidence, determiner and decision authority before finalization.
cases.expect: The immutable assessment supplies an actual-level assertion without changing capability identity.

cases.input: A coverage projection emits only unrealized, partially realized, realized-but-low-maturity and unassessed.
cases.expect: Rejected; an explicit unknown state is required by the missingness invariant.

cases.input: 'realized-but-low-maturity' is emitted as a single coverage state value.
cases.expect: Rejected; realization state and maturity state are reported as an orthogonal pair.

cases.input: A required level is written directly onto the BusinessCapability record.
cases.expect: Rejected; required level belongs to a capability-requirement record with driverRef, horizon and pinned scaleRef.

cases.input: A finalized assessment states an actual level with no scaleRef and no scale version.
cases.expect: Rejected; scale and scale version are pinned before results.

cases.input: A finalized assessment is recomputed against a later scale version.
cases.expect: Rejected; finalized assessments change only by amendment or supersession.

cases.input: A finalized assessment changes the capability's outcomeClass or name.
cases.expect: Rejected; assessment does not create, rename or redefine a capability.

cases.input: WM-ACT-001 is listed in the profile bases array.
cases.expect: Rejected; only WM-ACT-034 is profiled and WM-ACT-001 appears solely as a CapabilityRealization referent.

cases.input: The profile artifact declares no allocationState, canonicalPublishable, holds, profileVersion or fixtures.
cases.expect: Rejected; profile artifacts carry the same governance shape as allocation candidates.

cases.input: A validation policy containing no candidateName, contourId or target is applied to an artifact.
cases.expect: Rejected; each validation policy binds to exactly one named target artifact.

cases.input: A candidate passes validation on counts alone while declared invariants are unmapped to fixtures and negative fixtures carry no expectedCode.
cases.expect: Rejected; every declared invariant maps to at least one fixture and every negative fixture carries expectedCode.

cases.input: A legacy WM-ACT-001 instance whose capability and capabilityAttribution carried enterprise meaning is auto-promoted into a BusinessCapability record.
cases.expect: Rejected; promotion requires an approved crosswalk and unmapped legacy instances resolve to unknown.

cases.input: A new enterprise-capability instance is written against narrowed WM-ACT-001 after the narrowing effective date.
cases.expect: Rejected; enterprise-capability use of WM-ACT-001 is write-frozen from the narrowing effective date.

cases.input: WM-ACT-001 is narrowed with no version bump, deprecation note or migration-boundary record.
cases.expect: Rejected; a breaking narrowing of a published legacy model carries an explicit versioned boundary record.

cases.input: The reconciled invariant set omits adjudicated rules on assessment not renaming a capability, concurrent realizations, ending a realization not retiring a capability, sibling exclusivity, and determiner separate from decision authority, with no disposition recorded.
cases.expect: Rejected; every adjudicated invariant carries an accept, reject or defer disposition with a stated reason.

cases.input: One party records both the determination and the decision authority on a finalized assessment with no impartiality record.
cases.expect: Rejected; determiner and decision authority are separated and assessor competence and impartiality are recorded.
